name: YUCHAN - LAUNCH concept, vertical version, refined (user decisions 2026-11-04)
frame: s_z: s = arc length on the avionics_module's outer skin (r = body_r) from the copy azimuth theta_c, theta = theta_c + s / r (vehicle frame, from +X toward +Y); +s = RIGHT seen from outside with the nose up (not mirrored) at every azimuth.  z = print z = vehicle z - the part's lower end (Layout.z_avionics_bottom).  One polygon set for both copies and both configurations.
reading: Reads bottom -> top along the vehicle axis.  Seen beside the upright vehicle the letter tops point to the LEFT (head tilted left), on both copies; laid down nose-right it reads normally, upright.
inlay: flush 2-colour inlay on the OUTER wall line only (0.42 mm deep), 2 white lines behind it; no relief
refine_changes: Y and A terminals: the small upright 'ears' (0.11 H) are removed; every convex corner sharper than 75 deg (the two Y arm tips and the A's left foot) gets the same square chamfer (1.3 mm facet, cut perpendicular to its stroke); no corner below 78 deg is left.
Letter gap 2.5 -> 2.7 mm, C-H kern -0.5 -> -0.4; letter-to-stripe gap 2.0 -> 2.6 mm.
Exhaust dashes 5.2 / 4.4 / 3.9 mm long (2.2 mm wide), gaps 1.8 / 2.1 / 2.4 mm; smallest island 8.46 mm2.
Letter widths x 0.975 (Y alone 1.19 H, kerned 0.9 mm closer to the U); cap height 11.8, stem 2.6, bar 2.3, slant 12 deg, stripe 2.2 -> 4.0 mm unchanged.
Corners: convex orange r 0.35, concave orange corner / white wedge r 0.70, by construction (closing, then opening).
Composition: reads bottom -> top along the axis (letter tops to the left seen from outside, nose up); the word is centred across the copy azimuth; the exhaust dashes trail below it toward the tail.

summary_M.note: measured on these polygons by this script; check_geometry's livery check re-measures strokes / gaps / islands / clearances on the placed polygons

cad_set.note: cad/layout.py builds the inlay from polygons_s_z_cad (fewer faces for the booleans / BRep distances; the design set's 32-segment corner arcs are below the slicer's resolution)
